_comment: Decision constants for experiment ab5 (design d5: lint pre-pass + PN1 four-reviewer panel + deterministic merge + ADJ + cleaned VERIFY). Rule constants copied unchanged from ab4/decision.json (= ab1 plan sections 2-3, owner decisions D2-D4, D6). Read by harness.py analyze; no threshold literal lives in code. Cost is judged only after runs complete (D6): no run is ever stopped or skipped on token cost.
_comment_A_BASE: baseline mean LOOP output tokens (loop only; deduplicated by message id). R_LOOP = LOOP_T / A_BASE decides cost.
_comment_B_BASE: baseline loop + one audit; R_B = TOK_T / B_BASE is reported only, never decides.
_comment_B_DEFAULT: single-audit baseline values of section 2; recomputed over 12 audits when baseline-audit2 exists (else every comparison is PROVISIONAL).
_comment_MIN_COMPLETED: fewer completed Sonnet runs than this gives INCONCLUSIVE (5 of 6, 8 of 9).

rules._comment_DROP2_RLOOP_LIMIT: D6 conversion: R_LOOP_limit = (L*169468 - 69044)/100424 with original L = 2.0 on R_B (loop + audit) -> 2.6875, rounded 2.69. Replaces the plan's R_LOOP > 2.0. Post-hoc verdict clause only, never a mid-run stop.
rules._comment_DROP4_PASS_MIN: DROP-4 fires when loop PASS count < this (5/6 at n=6, 8/9 at n=9).
rules._comment_ADOPT_AUDFAIL_FACTOR: audit FAIL count <= floor(factor * B_AUDFAIL * n_audits): 5/12 at n=6, 7/18 at n=9.

haiku._comment_harness_fail_margin: ADOPT needs Haiku harness-failure rate <= Haiku baseline rate + this (one run in four), and 1 - HR > 0.

_comment_LOOP_INCLUDES_ADJ: PN1 rules.json tokens.loop_steps_include_adjudication = true (D2 counts the adjudication worker in the loop). analyze reports LOOP with and without ADJ; the decision uses this flag.
_comment_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS: at most this many runs have workers in flight at once; inside a run every prepared step is launched (up to 4 parallel R1 panel launches, ADJ in parallel with VF1, AUD with AUD2). Env AB_MAX overrides.
_comment_HAIKU_ENABLED: BRIEF: the Haiku stratum is not built in ab5. The code path (names, expected models, analysis) is kept; build --stratum haiku refuses while this is false.

frozen._comment: cmd_sha: the /sc:spec-panel command (identical to the frozen audit command, aud_cmd_sha; same file and sha as ab4 and PN1). rules_sha: ab1 rules + PN2 lint bullets + four-review wording (make_rules.py). aud_rules_sha: frozen audit rules (p11/rules.md, as ab4/PN1). panel_*: PN1 product panel template, tier table (MODEL-TIERS) and resolver code, byte copies of p13/clones/pn1/src/superclaude/cli/review/{data/*.json,panel.py}.
frozen._comment_full: rules_full_sha: PN1 product rules (rules-pn1.md = the file PN1 reviewers read, sha rules_pn1_sha) + PN2 lint bullets (make_rules.full_rules). pn1_vendor: byte copies of p13/clones/pn1/src/superclaude/cli/review/{findings,ledger,merge_cmd,ledger_cmd}.py; __init__.py is an ab5 shim (the PN1 one imports click and registers commands). merge_cmd.py / ledger_cmd.py are kept for reference only: ab5 calls ledger.merge_round / render_merged_report / apply_revision / defer and findings.parse_block / parse_fixmap in-process exactly as those two click commands do.

panel._comment: Panel (owner correction 2026-11-10): ab5 template frozen/review-panel.ab5.json = one reviewer per tier t1b, t2, t3, t4 (PN1's default was t1b, t2, t3, t3), resolved per run with the PN1 resolver (pn1_panel.resolve) and the PN1 tier table, environment anthropic-only. Mock: t1b-1 -> Sonnet 5.5 (real), t2-1 / t3-1 / t4-1 -> Haiku 5.5 stand-ins (stand_in=true): the same compute as PN1's 1 Sonnet + 3 Haiku, only the slot labels change. The AC sweep sentence goes only on t1b-1. A run survives one lost panel reviewer; two lost lose the run (PN1). ADJ model: Sonnet 5.5 (OWNER RULE: Fable / Tier 0 forbidden; PN1 used fable, so this is a changed condition), Haiku in the Haiku stratum.

lint._comment: PN2 live check set (offline pass 2: REF is the only check with MP>=0.8 and CLEAN=0); code copied unchanged to reqlint.py (p13/clones/pn2 lint.py, product ref 448048ae).

_comment_FRESH_LOOP_BASE: coordinator 2026-11-10: fresh-baseline loop output tokens; analyze reports three headline ratios against it (total loop, primary lane only, primary + adjudicator). Reported only; the pre-registered decide() still uses A_BASE.

lanes._comment: Lanes by PANEL SLOT for first-review steps (R1.<slot>-<i>) and by step otherwise; data. Owner correction 2026-11-10: primary = slot t1b + VF / revise / re-review / ADJ steps (all on Sonnet); tier234 = slots t2, t3, t4 (parallel other-provider lane, Haiku stand-ins in the mock), reported per slot with the live model beside the stand-in used; audit = AUD/AUD2, excluded from every loop total. ADJ is inside the primary lane but also shown as its own column so it stays visible.

FORBIDDEN_MODELS._comment: OWNER RULE 2026-11-10: Fable (Tier 0) is strictly forbidden; Opus 5.5 (Tier 1a) is the highest tier allowed and ab5 uses it for no step. build() and expected_model() refuse any step / panel slot whose model or alias matches one of these (case-insensitive).

panel._comment: BRIEF.md: ab4 + PN1 panel + ab4-style merge over the four reports (cleaned blocks) + ADJ + clean VF.

full._comment: owner change 2026-11-10: ab4 + everything in PN1: panel, PN1 merge with the typed ledger, ADJ over ledger rows, ledger-driven revise, PN1 re-review sandboxes/inputs; ab4 layers on top (lint, AC sweep on t1b-1, cleaned blocks, clean VF, confirmed line, ids_from cross-check, token matcher).

_comment_ADJ_GATES_VF1: false (default): ADJ is prepared with VF1 and runs beside it (PN1 ran ADJ beside V1); ADJ feeds no loop decision, so order only changes wall time. true: VF1 waits until ADJ is done (strict panel -> merge -> ADJ -> VF order).

live_alias_map._comment: OWNER 2026-11-10 (corrected): gateway alias -> LIVE model, data only. Mock -> live = this map + reviewer_models.stand_in=false, nothing else. tier1a is a documented alias only: the ab5 panel has no t1a slot (Opus is not in the panel).

claude-gw-tier1a[1m].name: Opus 5.5
claude-gw-tier1a[1m].note: documented only; allowed ceiling, not used

claude-gw-tier4[1m].name: GPT-6 Luna
claude-gw-tier4[1m].note: MODEL-TIERS 'Budget', notably weaker than the other panel models

reviewer_models._comment: true = CURRENT mock run: the panel resolves exactly as PN1 (pn1_panel + frozen tier table, anthropic-only): t1b -> the real primary model, t2/t3 slots -> Haiku stand-ins carrying stand_in=true in panel.json, state and telemetry; each reviewer also records live_model / live_name from live_alias_map for labels. false = LIVE: every reviewer's model / model_name / launch come from live_alias_map[alias] and stand_in=false.
